categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen Ampron Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in the research, development, production, and sales of thermistors and temperature sensors, oxygen sensors, pressure sensors, and force sensors. The company operates primarily in the manufacturing of sensitive components and sensors, serving industries such as automotive, home appliances, photovoltaics, energy storage, charging stations, IoT, industrial control, medical, and robotics.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced ceramic materials technology, MEMS (Micro-Electro-Mechanical Systems) technology, and integrated circuit (IC) design. It has a vertically integrated manufacturing platform covering material formulation, ceramic substrate preparation, forming, sintering, printing, packaging, MEMS pressure sensor chip design, calibration, module assembly, and testing. The company also employs glass microfusion and thick-film printing processes and has developed integrated temperature-pressure sensors and force sensors based on MEMS and glass microfusion technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading domestic and international brands in automotive (e.g., BYD, SAIC, Stellantis, NIO, XPeng), home appliances (e.g., Midea, Gree, Haier, TCL), photovoltaics, energy storage, and industrial sectors. The company serves automotive OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers, home appliance manufacturers, and emerging markets such as robotics and medical devices. Its products are widely used in automotive engine systems, chassis and braking systems, body and comfort systems, and various consumer electronics.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with manufacturing and R&D bases in Shenzhen, Dongguan, Hunan, Shanghai, and Europe (Belgium). It has established subsidiaries in Europe and plans to expand production capacity in Thailand. The company serves domestic markets extensively and exports to North America, Europe, Japan, South Korea, and India, with a growing presence in overseas automotive and home appliance markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Ampron operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the manufacturing of core sensor components and modules. It controls the entire production process from raw material development to finished sensor products, supplying directly to OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers in automotive and other industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation with significant R&D investment focused on enhancing sensitive ceramic materials, MEMS technology, and IC design capabilities. It is developing new sensor types such as six-axis force sensors, MEMS piezoelectric sensors, and integrated temperature-pressure sensors. Expansion of R&D centers in Europe and Shanghai aims to attract global talent and strengthen IC design. The company also emphasizes smart manufacturing, digitalization, and automation to improve production efficiency and product quality.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of sensor products including thermistors, temperature sensors, pressure sensors, oxygen sensors, and force sensors. The company sells mainly via direct sales to OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers, supplemented by distributor sales. Revenue recognition occurs upon transfer of control of goods to customers, either domestically or through export contracts.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Ampron is recognized as a leading domestic player in the automotive-grade pressure sensor market, achieving significant import substitution. It is among the few Chinese companies covering low, medium, and high-pressure sensor ranges for automotive applications. The company is ranked among China's top sensor companies and holds a strong position in sensitive ceramic and MEMS sensor technologies, competing with global sensor manufacturers in automotive and industrial sectors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 940 million, a 25.93% increase year-over-year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 82.6 million, up 3.44%. The pressure sensor segment grew by 32.17%, becoming the largest revenue contributor. R&D expenses increased by 32.10% to RMB 62.6 million, representing 6.66% of revenue. The company has expanded its production capacity and continues to invest in new product development and international market expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Ampron emphasizes its vertically integrated manufacturing platform combining advanced ceramic materials, MEMS technology, and IC design to deliver high-performance, reliable, and precise sensors. Its products feature high sensitivity, accuracy, durability, and are tailored to meet stringent automotive and industrial standards. The company offers a broad product portfolio with thousands of specifications, strong customization capabilities, and a robust quality management system certified by IATF16949 and ISO9001, ensuring zero-defect quality and timely delivery to global customers.
